title: Provenance Sidecar
description: Provenance sidecar for an AuthoredMaster in media-src/. Path = master path with extension replaced by .json (extension-swap). Strict: unknown fields are rejected. Validation is fail-fast in build-images.mjs; no-op when sidecar absent; an orphan sidecar (no corresponding master in media-src/) is a fail-fast error (orphan-sidecar), symmetric with findUnreferencedAssets === []. Tier A review block is optional in schema but required (with decision=approve) for master-integration commits, enforced fail-closed in the CI step (fetch-depth: 0, forward-only).

name.description: Basename of the master (e.g. frame-01.svg). Must match the master basename.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the master bytes, 64 lowercase hex.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of authoring (Z or +00:00).

inputs.description: Optional list of input assets used to produce the master.

review.description: Optional Tier A human review block. Required (with decision=approve) for master-integration commits touching media-src/, enforced in CI.

reviewer.description: Reviewer name (self-review acceptable for solo maintainer).

oversight.description: Project-defined vocabulary for human-authored masters (not C2PA's humanOversightLevel, which applies only to AI-generated content).

notes.description: Side-by-side notes: size, format, qualitative impression, palette/tonal-range verification.

measuredSSIM.description: Optional Tier B fidelity measurement (SSIM value; PSNR reported separately when available).
